QuestInfo.name: [Earth Day] Greetings... From Earth!
QuestInfo.0: Earth Day is here, so of course Cassandra has something for you to do.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra will give you a special gift if you help her clean up Maple World in commemoration of Earth Day.
QuestInfo.2: Cassandra will give you a special gift if you help her clean up Maple World in commemoration of Earth Day.

0.0: This green land! These blue skies!\r\nWe've gotta do everything we can to keep the #bEarth#k clean and beautiful. And Maple World too, I guess.
0.1: I'm doing my part by not driving or setting things on fire.\r\nYou should do your part by cleaning up for me!
0.2: How about it? Do you love this planet, or are you filthy and selfish?

no.0: Are you sure you don't want the amazing gifts?! Well, I'll be waiting in case you change your mind.

yes.0: Click the #battendance check icon#k #i3800423# if you need to see what goodies I'm bribing you with this time.\r\nOf course, I know in your heart that you just want to make Maple World a better place. Like me!
